title: Profile / Avatar - Sun-Drenched Candid Selfie Portrait
summary: Creates a realistic, handheld selfie-style street photo with natural lighting and a film-like aesthetic, using an uploaded reference for identity.
prompt: Use my uploaded portrait only for facial identity and hairstyle. Create a {argument name="photo style" default="realistic handheld selfie-style street photo"}, close-up wide-angle perspective, the person reaching one arm toward the camera, natural casual outfit chosen to suit the person. {argument name="background" default="Summer tree-lined street background"}, strong sunlight filtering through leaves, soft backlight, overexposed highlights, slight motion blur, candid phone-photo feeling, natural skin texture, realistic face, cinematic but unpolished, 3:4 vertical composition
